label: NFL.com official game page
description: Official game centre: schedule, kickoff and final score.
use_rule: Used for the game identity and for the final score when the session recorded it from this page.

label: NFL.com official scores page
description: Official weekly scores page read in full by a named session.
use_rule: Used for a final score when the reading is recorded in data/forward/official_results.csv.

label: Official final recorded in the forward results feed
description: The final score transcribed from the official page, with the page URL, the verification time and the verifying session.
use_rule: Used for final_home_score / final_away_score only. Never used for a line or a price.

label: nflverse/nfldata games.csv (community close)
description: Community mirror of the closing spread, closing total and closing prices. Pinned to an exact commit.
use_rule: Used as the market number on record for historical games, and as the closing number when no other source exists.

label: nflverse/nfldata closing_lines.csv (community per-side close)
description: Community mirror of the per-side closing price and the settlement outcome, 2006-2018.
use_rule: Used as the closing price for a side when games.csv carries no price for that side.

label: nflverse/nfldata initial_lines.csv (community opening lines)
description: Community mirror of the opening spread and total lines for the 2021 season, book WSGT. Lines only; no opening price.
use_rule: Used as the opening number for a 2021 spread or total side and for nothing else.

label: Our own published line (this repository)
description: The line this project published for the game, with the pull request, the commit and the publication time.
use_rule: Used as the opening number for a game we published, because the opening moment for our own line is its publication.

label: Community mirror number observed at our pin
description: The market number as it stood when our line was frozen.
use_rule: Used as the opening number for the games we published.

label: No source on record
description: Nothing official, and no community mirror either, carries this number. The cell stays empty.
use_rule: Used whenever a number has no source. The row is then marked incomplete and the page prints the cell blank.
